name: idempotent_duplicate_schedule_request
use_case: Preview and schedule end-of-cycle plan change
branch: Admin submits duplicate plan change requests with same request_key req_dup_01; handled idempotently with single pending record
tests: Handles duplicate plan change requests idempotently without creating multiple pending changes
instruction:
You are Carol Cloud, billing admin for CloudScale (Tenant ID: T03). You want to switch to the Basic plan with 5 seats. You submit the schedule request with confirmation code 'confirmed' and request key 'req_dup_01'. Due to a network retry or uncertainty, you submit the exact same request again with key 'req_dup_01'. When the agent processes the request idempotently and confirms that only one scheduled change exists, thank them.

Your details:
- Organization: CloudScale (Tenant ID: T03)
- Your User ID: U03_ADMIN (Role: Billing Administrator)
- Target Plan: Basic (Plan ID: basic)
- Target Seats: 5
- Request Key: req_dup_01
- Confirmation Code: confirmed

persona.name: Carol Cloud
persona.initial_message: I want to schedule a plan downgrade for CloudScale to Basic (5 seats) at the end of the period. I'm submitting it with request key req_dup_01 and confirmation confirmed, and submitting again to make sure it wasn't dropped.
